summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan for Mentora, an educational bridge platform for the Habesha community (Grades 1-6) featuring 3 distinct portals (Parent, Tutor, Admin), pricing packages (Private 3,500 ETB, Group 2,500 ETB), the 8-track Summer Camp program, 5 incentive rules, supplementary books/tips library, and Amharic/English language toggle.
